claims.claim: The company develops, manufactures and sells LED chips, LED components, LED modules, sensor components and systems.
claims.quote: We develop, manufacture and sell light emitting diode (LED) chips and LED components, LED modules, sensor components incorporating LED or VCSEL and systems.

claims.claim: Manufacturing starts with epitaxial growth of GaN layers on sapphire wafers followed by deposition of a reflective silver layer and copper alloy.
claims.quote: Utilizing our patented and proprietary technology, our manufacturing process begins by growing upon the surface of a sapphire wafer, or substrate, several very thin separate semiconductive crystalline layers of gallium nitride, or GaN, a process known as epitaxial growth, on top of which a mirror‑like reflective silver layer is then deposited.

claims.claim: The firm optimizes epitaxial growth to improve light‑to‑electric conversion efficiency.
claims.quote: optimizing our epitaxial growth processes to create layers that efficiently convert electrical current into light;

claims.claim: Technical capabilities allow production of LED chips, modules, sensor components and system products while reducing reliance on sapphire.
claims.quote: These technical capabilities enable us to produce LED chips, LED component, LED modules, sensor components incorporating LED or VCSEL and system products.

claims.claim: The company operates a fabless model, using foundry fabs for chip ODM and seeking to sell idle chip‑making equipment.
claims.quote: We have moved to a fabless business model in which we utilize foundry fabs to ODM our chips using our developed technology and continue to explore opportunities to sell our chip manufacturing equipment, which will help us to reduce the idle capacity costs.

claims.claim: Sales are conducted via a direct sales force, Japanese development partners and third‑party distributors.
claims.quote: We market and sell our products through both our direct sales force, Japanese development partners and distributors.

claims.claim: Management plans to keep expanding sales coverage in Asia.
claims.quote: We plan to continue expanding our sales coverage in Asia as we grow our business.

claims.claim: The firm provides technology‑development services leveraging its MOCVD EPI and advanced packaging expertise.
claims.quote: We provide technology services as a technology development partner for companies that value our MOCVD EPI and advanced packaging knowledge.

claims.claim: Customer concentration is high – the top ten customers generated roughly 96% of FY2026 revenue.
claims.quote: For the years ended August 31, 2026 and 2025, our top ten customers collectively accounted for 96% and 99% of our revenues, respectively.

claims.claim: Management states its advanced technology is a competitive advantage in a fast‑changing LED market.
claims.quote: We believe that our advanced technology helps us to compete in the innovative, intensely competitive and rapidly changing market of LED design and manufacturing.

claims.claim: The company competes with larger LED chip and packaging manufacturers that have greater resources.
claims.quote: We compete with many LED chip manufacturers and LED packaging manufacturers, many of which compete directly with us and are much larger than us.

claims.claim: Competitors often possess longer histories, larger financial and marketing resources, and stronger customer relationships.
claims.quote: Some of our existing and potential competitors possess significant advantages, including longer operating histories, greater financial, technical, managerial, marketing, distribution and other resources, more long‑standing and established relationships with our existing and potential customers, greater name recognition, larger customer bases and greater government incentives and support.

claims.claim: As of August 31 2026 the company held 74 U.S. patents and 10 pending patents, plus additional foreign filings.
claims.quote: As of August 31, 2026, we had 74 patents issued and 10 patents pending with the United States Patent and Trademark Office covering various aspects of our core technologies.

claims.claim: Revenue declined sharply in FY2026 to $19.1 million from $43.0 million in FY2025.
claims.quote: Revenues for fiscal year 2026 decreased to $19.1 million, compared to $43.0 million in fiscal year 2025.

claims.claim: Gross margin improved to 21% in FY2026 versus 6% in FY2025.
claims.quote: GAAP gross margin for fiscal year 2026 increased to 21%, compared to 6% for fiscal year 2025.

claims.claim: Management expects buy‑sell equipment orders to continue in FY2027, providing a significant, albeit volatile, revenue source.
claims.quote: In fiscal years 2026 and 2025, the Company entered into a number of buy‑sell orders for equipment that it purchased and then sold to its customers, and the Company anticipates continuing to receive buy‑sell purchase orders in fiscal year 2027.

claims.claim: Management has shifted focus from general lighting to industrial UV applications.
claims.quote: SemiLEDs had moved away from general lighting markets due to extreme price erosion led by companies in China. We have moved on to focus on industrial UV applications.

claims.claim: The firm is moving down the supply chain to offer full UV LED lamp systems.
claims.quote: we moved down the supply chain, supplying customers with full UV LED lamp systems.

claims.claim: Management plans continued R&D on sensor components and other innovative products with partners.
claims.quote: We expect to continue our efforts at further research and development of innovative products such as sensor components together with our partners.

claims.claim: A cost‑reduction program has been implemented to accelerate operating expense cuts and improve efficiency.
claims.quote: We have implemented certain actions to accelerate operating cost reductions and improve operational efficiencies in response to changes in the economic environment, our industry and demand.

claims.claim: The company intends to continue expanding sales coverage in Asian markets as it grows the business.
claims.quote: We plan to continue expanding our sales coverage in Asia as we grow our business.

claims.claim: Risk disclosures note that dependence on contract manufacturers could materially affect operations if those partners fail to deliver on time or to required quality.
claims.quote: The inability of our contract manufacturers to produce products that satisfy our requirements may have a material adverse effect on our business.

claims.claim: Intellectual‑property litigation risk is highlighted, with potential for costly defenses or injunctions that could impair product availability.
claims.quote: Defending against any intellectual property infringement claims would likely result in costly litigation and ultimately may lead to our not being able to manufacture, use or sell products found to be infringing.

claims.claim: Management’s strategic judgment is to seek additional revenue by monetizing idle equipment and patents while maintaining focus on UV‑LED growth.
claims.quote: The cost reduction plan is further enhanced through the fabless business model in which we implemented certain workforce reductions and have sold certain patents that we were no longer actively developing and are exploring the opportunities to consign or sell certain equipment related to the manufacturing of vertical LED chips to reduce the idle capacity charges, minimize our research and development activities associated with chips manufacturing operation.

gaps: No filing evidence quantifies the exact proportion of revenue derived from UV‑LED applications versus other segments.
No disclosed timeline or budget for the planned expansion of R&D resources beyond the qualitative statements.
No specific data on future capital expenditures for new production capacity is provided.
insight: Insight: The company anticipates continuing buy‑sell purchase orders in fiscal year 2027, indicating that equipment resales will remain a key revenue source despite overall sales decline — EX-99.1 line 15: In fiscal years 2026 and 2025, the Company entered into a number of buy‑sell orders for equipment that it purchased and then sold to its customers, and the Company anticipates continuing to receive buy‑sell purchase orders in fiscal year 2027.
